title: How we built a 21-game HTML5 Arcade Portal in weeks using "Vibe Coding" & agentic AI
author: Same-Singer7368

comments.author: fsk
comments.body:
Why do you attempt to vibe code a game you've never played?  I tried your space invaders, lots of obvious things you missed if you ever played real Space Invaders:

- shields at the bottom of the screen
- bonus saucer
- invaders speed up as they're destroyed
- invaders start lower each cleared wave

replies.author: Same-Singer7368
replies.body: These are all valid — and honestly, fair critique. We built a “Neon Invaders” inspired by Space Invaders but didn’t nail the original mechanics. Speed increase on destruction, shields, bonus saucer, wave progression — all noted and going on the update list. Thanks for actually playing and giving specific feedback.

replies.author: fsk
replies.body:
> —

Oh boy, I'm talking to an AI and not a real person.

replies.author: Same-Singer7368
replies.body: But I need feedback to improve my gaming website, want to grow it with good user experience and working on it consistently.
